subject: Activation itinerary & MAP: Canary window, migration sequence, and training cadence
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Moreno <alexa@blueharbor.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 16 Aug 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Activation itinerary & MAP: Canary window, migration sequence, and training cadence

Alexa —

Thanks again for the quick signature. Attached is a draft activation itinerary that we built into the mutual action plan (MAP). High level summary and asks below so we can lock dates this week: 

- Goal: Production traffic ramp in a staged rollout with a 72‑hour canary window, full migration 4 weeks after canary start, and two instructor‑led training waves for support & ops.
- Key milestones (draft):
  • Week 0 (canary prep): infra smoke tests + integration runbook dry run (Redwood + BlueHarbor)
  • Week 1 (canary): 72‑hour canary with ~5% traffic, automated rollback hooks and KV cache priming
  • Week 3 (validation): post‑canary eval + perf/accuracy regression checks using MAP eval set
  • Week 4 (migration): staged cutover of remaining endpoints in two waves, followed by hypercare 7 days
- Primary owners: Redwood (onboarding/ops) — Jonas/Marissa; BlueHarbor (product/procurement) — Alexa + procurement contact.

Attaching: MAP_Activation_Itinerary_v1.xlsx (milestone dates), Canary-Test-Script.md (test steps).

Questions / asks for you:
1) Confirm canary start window: propose Mon 2025-09-01 08:00 PT (canary prep week begins Mon 2025-08-25).
2) Confirm training attendee list and preferred weekday for instructor sessions (we have two 90‑min sessions planned).
3) Procurement checklist: needs a completed SOC 2 snapshot and DocuSign envelope back to us by Aug 25 to keep the timeline intact.

If those dates look good I’ll route an updated MAP (with HubSpot checkpoint IDs) and a DocuSign envelope for the final SOW signature.

Best,
Jonas Weber
Senior Solutions Manager | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwood.com
(415) 555-0197

Attachments: MAP_Activation_Itinerary_v1.xlsx; Canary-Test-Script.md

From: Alexa Moreno <alexa@blueharbor.ai>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, BlueHarbor Labs - Procurement <procurement@blueharbor.ai>
Date: Mon, 18 Aug 2025 10:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation itinerary & MAP: Canary window, migration sequence, and training cadence

Jonas —

Thanks for the clear plan and the attachments. Quick notes from our side after a brief sync here: 

- Canary window: We like the 72‑hour approach but need it to run the following week (canary prep week starting Mon 2025-09-08) — we have a board release on Sep 2 that could add noise to metrics.
- Training: We’ll provide two cohorts: Support (ops) + Platform Eng. Prefer Tue/Thu sessions; can you do Tue 09/16 and Thu 09/18?
- Procurement: procurement@blueharbor.ai indicated they need retained logs retention policy language in the SOW and a sample SOC 2 readout. They can return the signed SOW by Aug 27 if we include the retention clause.

Also looping procurement in to flag the security ask. See inline: 

> On Sat, Aug 16, 2025 at 9:12 AM Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Attaching: MAP_Activation_Itinerary_v1.xlsx (milestone dates), Canary-Test-Script.md (test steps).

We’ll confirm final dates once procurement confirms the retention language.

Thanks — Alexa
Alexa Moreno
Director of Integrations | BlueHarbor Labs
alexa@blueharbor.ai

Attachments: (none)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 19 Aug 2025 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Activation itinerary & MAP: Canary window, migration sequence, and training cadence

Team —

Reviewed Alexa’s reply. A few internal adjustments and mitigating controls to add into the MAP before we send the version to procurement: 

1) Move canary start to week of 2025-09-08 as requested. Update MAP_Activation_Itinerary_v1.xlsx to v1.1 with new dates.
2) Canary safety net: add automated fallback to a lower‑capacity model variant at the 95th percentile latency threshold (config in runtime routing policy).
3) Validation gating: include a formal eval run (MAP eval set ID: HS-EVAL-0925) and require <1.5% accuracy delta vs baseline for go/no‑go.
4) Training deliverables: Training_Modules_SprintPlan.pdf attached — two sessions, plus an on‑demand recording and a short hands‑on lab for platform eng.
5) Add Rollback_RTO_RPO.pdf as an attachment for procurement to review retention and recovery commitments.

I’ll update the MAP workbook and call out these changes in the SOW appendix. Once procurement confirms retention language and SOC 2 snapshot, Jonas please send the DocuSign envelope and HubSpot checkpoint.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com

Attachments: Rollback_RTO_RPO.pdf; Training_Modules_SprintPlan.pdf

Alexa / procurement team —

Appreciate the quick feedback. We’ve incorporated Marissa’s changes into MAP_Activation_Itinerary_v1.1 and appended the Rollback RTO/RPO language for procurement’s review. Summary of confirmed items: 

- Canary start: Mon 2025-09-08 (72 hours)
- Training sessions: Tue 2025-09-16 (Support cohort) and Thu 2025-09-18 (Platform Eng cohort); on‑demand recording to be uploaded to shared Drive after first session.
- Procurement ask: retention clause added; SOC 2 snapshot attached to HubSpot; requested signed SOW by Aug 27.
- Validation gate: MAP eval set HS-EVAL-0925; pass threshold <1.5% accuracy delta.

Next steps (owner):
  • Jonas: Create DocuSign envelope for SOW (DocuSign link in related_links) and update HubSpot (HS-58321) — by EOD Aug 22.
  • Marissa: Publish training materials and update MAP workbook — by Aug 24.
  • Procurement (BlueHarbor): Return signed SOW and confirm retention wording — by Aug 27.

If procurement confirms by the 27th we keep the schedule; if not we’ll shift the canary by a week and notify teams.

Thanks everyone — looking forward to the kickoff.

—Jonas
Jonas Weber
